results.snippet: Though the risk of virus transmission is lower in asymptomatic people, they still have episodes of viral shedding when transmission can occur. And for the record, there’s no “How to prevent viral shedding” guide here — because you can’t.

results.snippet: How does genital herpes spread? Herpes can be spread when an infected person has lesions — blisters and open sores — on their body or when you do not have any symptoms. Taking antiviral medicine can help you reduce the risk of spreading genital herpes to your sexual partners.
